'''Crossing-the-bridge noodles''' is a rice noodle soup that originates from [[Yunnan]] province of China.<ref>{{cite web |author=<!-- not stated --> |date=August 19, 2013 |title= The Legend Behind Yunnan’s Famous Crossing the Bridge Noodles|url= https://wildchina.com/2013/08/crossing-the-bridge-noodles/|website= WildChina |location= China|publisher= |access-date=}}</ref> It is one of the best-known dishes in [[Yunnan cuisine]].<ref>{{cite web |author=<!-- not stated --> |date=August 17, 2023 |title= Yunnan's Delightful Bridge-Crossing Rice Noodles|url= https://www.chineselearning.com/chinese-food/yun-nan-delightful-bridge-crossing-rice-noodles|website= ChineseLearning |location= China|publisher= |access-date=}}</ref>
